info.name: Antifraud Lab API
info.description:
Requests and tests for the Antifraud Lab API.

The API key is set once, on the collection (Authorization tab), and every request inherits it - the same idea as the auth dependency on the /v1 router. Health checks opt out with No Auth; the wrong-key request sets its own.

Set `apiKey` in the `local` environment before running.
